title: Delphinidin inhibits retinal photochemical damage by regulating the cGAS-STING pathway to suppress NCOA4-mediated ferritinophagy.
authors: Wang, Hansheng; Zhu, Yanfeng; Song, Xiaolong; Pu, Haomou; Song, Jinjie; Jiang, Hongjie; Yu, Xiaoping; Xu, Yaji
journal: Journal of photochemistry and photobiology. B, Biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究花翠素通过cGAS-STING通路抑制视网膜光化学损伤中的铁蛋白自噬，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是细胞与疾病机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Retinal photochemical damage is associated with the development of ocular diseases, yet its underlying mechanisms are incompletely defined, and therapeutic strategies are limited. Delphinidin, an anthocyanidin with broad pharmacological activities, has been demonstrated to protect against retinal damage. However, the molecular basis of this effect remains unclear. Here, we investigated the pathogenic mechanisms of light-induced retinal damage and evaluated the therapeutic potential of delphinidin. We found that intense light exposure caused photoreceptor loss, accompanied by features of ferroptosis and autophagy, including disrupted iron homeostasis, lipid peroxidation, mitochondrial impairment, autophagosome accumulation, and dysregulated expression of key molecular mediators. Co-immunoprecipitation assays of FTH1 and NCOA4, together with confocal microscopy analyses of FTH1 and LAMP1 colocalization, demonstrated that light exposure exacerbates NCOA4-mediated ferritinophagy in retinal cells, whereas delphinidin attenuated this process. RNA-seq identified abnormal STING expression, and silencing STING with siRNA effectively inhibited NCOA4-mediated ferritinophagy induced by light exposure. Delphinidin modulated the cGAS-STING pathway by reducing light-induced DNA damage. Molecular docking further suggested that delphinidin may occupy the ATP-binding pocket of cGAS, indicating a potential competitive inhibitory interaction. These findings, for the first time in the context of photochemical retinal damage, identify STING activation and NCOA4-mediated ferritinophagy as contributors to retinal ferroptosis, and highlight delphinidin as a therapeutic candidate that acts by inhibiting cGAS-STING signaling, with molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, and CETSA assays suggesting that delphinidin exerts its retinal protective effect by engaging the ATP-binding pocket of cGAS.
abstract_zh: 视网膜光化学损伤与眼部疾病的发生发展相关，但其潜在机制尚未完全阐明，治疗策略也有限。飞燕草素（Delphinidin）是一种具有广泛药理活性的花青素，已被证明可保护视网膜免受损伤。然而，其作用的分子基础仍不清楚。在此，我们研究了光诱导视网膜损伤的致病机制，并评估了飞燕草素的治疗潜力。我们发现，强光暴露导致感光细胞丢失，并伴随铁死亡（ferroptosis）和自噬（autophagy）的特征，包括铁稳态紊乱、脂质过氧化、线粒体损伤、自噬体积累以及关键分子介质表达失调。FTH1和NCOA4的免疫共沉淀实验，以及FTH1和LAMP1共定位的共聚焦显微镜分析表明，光暴露加剧了视网膜细胞中NCOA4介导的铁蛋白自噬（ferritinophagy），而飞燕草素则减弱了这一过程。RNA-seq鉴定出STING的异常表达，且通过siRNA沉默STING有效抑制了光暴露诱导的NCOA4介导的铁蛋白自噬。飞燕草素通过减少光诱导的DNA损伤来调节cGAS-STING通路。分子对接进一步提示，飞燕草素可能占据cGAS的ATP结合口袋，表明其具有潜在的竞争性抑制相互作用。这些发现首次在光化学视网膜损伤背景下，确定STING激活和NCOA4介导的铁蛋白自噬是视网膜铁死亡的促成因素，并强调飞燕草素作为通过抑制cGAS-STING信号发挥作用的治疗候选药物，其中分子对接、分子动力学模拟和CETSA实验提示，飞燕草素通过结合cGAS的ATP结合口袋发挥其视网膜保护作用。
